commits.message: the marketplace's pages are written by the site at engenty.ai, at /wizards/<slug> and /de/wizards/<slug>
a banner in the studio says when a newer release is out; the update installs from there, the runtime restarts into the new version and the page reloads
the studio chat counts the seconds of a turn and says what the architect is doing and thinking; pasted pictures show in the thread and the architect sees them
video models render at 720p, or 480p when a step asks; a larger clip is scaled down, and the price follows the resolution
the settings say Codex makes images on the sign-in too; only video and audio still need a key
plan for a setup by capability
a wizard says which models it lacks before it runs, and only refuses to start when every path needs one; templates can be filtered by capability, and those this install cannot run are greyed out

Codex makes images on the ChatGPT plan, and runs each model class on its own model (Luna, Sol, Astra); image, video and voice stay empty without a gateway key instead of naming models nothing can reach
the changelog's groups read NEW, FIXED, DOCS in every language, like the entries they stand before
the publish job fetches the package artifact by name; with one artifact left it no longer lands in its own folder
a marketplace entry opens in the local studio at localhost:24368 instead of the Mac app's engenty-wizards:// link

the Mac app is no longer built or offered; the studio offers to install itself as a Chrome app in a banner, starting at login on a Mac is a LaunchAgent that runs the command, and the setup, README and docs point there

engenty wizards starts at login — the Mac app opens in the menu bar without its window ("Open at Login" in its menus), on Linux a systemd user service; the setup asks, `engenty-wizards autostart on|off` switches it, and the Mac app's server takes port 24368 too
the setup page installs a missing AI client in its own terminal, and both setups suggest the client whose app is on the Mac — its subscription is most likely already paid for
an inline terminal's stream sends its last lines and its end before it closes; a page that opens it afterwards gets them all
the German tagline on the sign-in page follows the new one
the studio says when a newer release is out and, on an install made by wizards.sh, updates it from the footer
the tagline is "Make a wish. Get your wizard." In the README, the npm package description and the banner of wizards.sh.
the local runtime listens on 24368, AGENT on a phone keypad; the Docker image stays on 8891
Ctrl-C stops engenty-wizards again — the login shell that reads the person's variables runs in a session of its own and no longer keeps the terminal
wizards.sh opens with the tall engenty — one eye; it wakes up, looks around, hops and blinks
the studio moves to /studio; the root of a host is free for a landing page
the marketplace is an app of its own; the runtime searches it live and keeps its starters and the starred entries for offline use
engenty-wizards://new?starter=<id> opens a marketplace template in the desktop app
install with wizards.sh; the local install and how its pieces share it
the desktop app is a window on the local install and brings no runtime along
an installer, wizards.sh, that every runtime serves
an engenty-wizards command for a local install in ~/.engenty/wizards
the search skips filler words with umlauts too
the gallery's footer stays without version, changelog and open-source links
a changelog and open-source credits in the studio's footer; pnpm release cuts a release from the commits
an entry's search terms are scored one by one, not as one long text
marketplace entries carry the words people ask for, so a search by words finds them
one project unless the limit says more; an account page; previews and layouts in the project settings
a project holds base infos, logos, colours, assets, documents and facts for all its wizards
the gallery has the studio's footer line
the gallery's field is narrower
the gallery invites to start a wizard from a template
a template's header is the dialog's own colour under a spotlight; in the light a tinted grey
a template opens with its flow as a diagram; the gallery's field is narrower, its chips centred
the gallery says what it is, compact and from the left; its search is a two-line field to write into
the gallery opens with one question and the search field; quieter filter chips
the marketplace search asks the model for the signed-in tenant; a sentence without a model keeps only close finds
a marketplace of wizards to start from, with a gallery, admin, translation and search
AI media is marked in its file and labelled with the EU icons (AI Act, Art. 50)
two writers of the same blob no longer share a temporary file
plan for definition versions and importing older packages
wizard packages carry their own extension, .wizard
wizards export as a package (.wizard.zip) and import into a project
the editor pane's resize handle is a short, thick pill
chat composer takes files (+) and dictation
editor side pane resizable; Steps tab steps with ← / →, header and strip spacing fixed
the arrow on a live wizard's card opens it in a new tab
the AI clients page says it is an MCP server and sets a client up step by step
settings in sub-pages with a nav on the left (a dropdown on phones); MCP servers under Connectors
settings button in the top bar; the user menu closes on Einstellungen
at most 5 projects per tenant
the project switcher switches the wizard list
light / dark in the user menu, in place of the top bar's toggle
upload limits and sorting, pictures while a step works, faster photo steps, a feedback box on reviews
starters for receipts, video ad, property film, window offer, menu plan and ten website helpers
photos reach an installed AI client, and a photo without text is described
embed a wizard in a website, inline or behind a button that opens it in a window
the editor at /edit/<id>, signed-out visitors of the start page go to SIGNED_OUT_URL
wizards at /w/<token>, the app at the root of https://engenty.ai
serve the app under a path (https://engenty.ai/w)
the hosted addresses (engenty.ai) as defaults, no private repo names in the public sources
the drop engenty as app icon, tray icon and favicon
a README for people who install it, developer notes in docs/development.md
a built runtime links to its own port, the sandbox falls back to agentOS
no links to the clients' pages, a placeholder dot in the footer
installed AI clients as the model of a local runtime, first-start setup as a wizard
align vertical head turn with pointer gaze
add furry and jelly renderers with an interactive builder
whole credits in the top bar, a footer line with the account's places
decision steps — yes/no and choice output fields, branches on step outputs
pnpm workspace with apps/ and packages/
desktop app — Tauri shell with the runtime as a Node sidecar
a database per tenant, model classes, sign-in at the Manage-App, phone inputs
engenty's built-in connectors — Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Contacts, Outlook, OneDrive, Slack, GitHub, HubSpot, S3
connectors from the integrations registry, asked-first changes in connected accounts
harden browser and file downloads, step navigation in the inspector, store and mailbox docs
light/dark mode with engenty-coloured dark pages, jelly and fur coats, quiet focus rings
lists and connections kept between runs, mail and browser tools, camera and ask panel
setup per AI client and a self-served plugin with /wizard
interactive widgets with a workspace per wizard, shareable results
live studio — MCP and other edits show up without a reload
OAuth sign-in for MCP clients, connected apps in settings
MCP endpoint for authoring wizards with personal API keys
engenty wizards — prompt-built AI wizards with shareable links
